tools.name: get_course_details
tools.description: Full details for one course: what it covers, how it is assessed, the pre-course online work, what to bring, when the certificate is issued, and how long it stays current. Use it to answer whether a course meets a workplace or childcare requirement. course is the id from list_courses; a unit code such as HLTAID011 also works.

course.description: The course's id, unit code, workshops course id or name.

tools.name: get_faqs
tools.description: Frequently asked questions and answers: which course a job needs, recognition, certificate timing, renewal, online learning, group training, cost, what to wear. Pass a topic to get the most relevant ones; omit it for all.

topic.description: A question or topic, such as How do I renew my certificate.

tools.name: list_courses
tools.description: List the nationally recognised first aid and CPR courses Australia Wide First Aid runs, with unit code (HLTAID009/011/012), price in AUD, duration, delivery (including any online pre-course learning) and renewal period. Use this to turn a need like "first aid for work" or "childcare certificate" into a course id for the other tools.

tools.name: list_locations
tools.description: List training venues with address, grouped by state. Pass state to narrow to one state, or near (an Australian postcode or suburb the person gives you, such as "4510" or "Caboolture QLD") to get the closest venues with their distance in km. The id of a venue is the location for search_sessions.

limit.description: With near, how many venues to return. Values below 1 use the default.

near.description: A postcode or suburb, optionally with its state, such as 4510 or Caboolture QLD.

state.description: A state or territory, such as QLD, in any case. Ignored when near is given.

tools.name: search_nearby_sessions
tools.description: Upcoming sessions of one course across the venues closest to a postcode or suburb, merged soonest first, with each venue's distance in km. near is required: this server can't tell where the person is, so ask them for their postcode or suburb. If a suburb exists in several states the reply lists the candidates: ask which one and retry with the state or postcode.

course.description: The course's id, unit code, workshops course id or name, as getCourseDetails accepts.

date_from.description: The first date to search, YYYY-MM-DD in Australia/Brisbane time. Defaults to today; a past date means today.

date_to.description: The last date to search, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 60 days after date_from and is capped at 365 days after it.

limit.description: How many sessions to return. Larger values are capped at 50; values below 1 use the default.

near.description: The person's Australian postcode or suburb, optionally with its state, such as 4510 or Caboolture QLD. Required: ask the person for it.

venues.description: How many of the closest venues to search. Larger values are capped at 5; values below 1 use the default.

tools.name: search_sessions
tools.description: Upcoming sessions of one course at one venue, soonest first: date, time, venue address, price, seats available (as the site shows them, such as "5+") and a session_id for start_booking. If the person gave a suburb or postcode rather than a venue, use search_nearby_sessions instead.

course.description: The course's id, unit code, workshops course id or name, as getCourseDetails accepts.

date_from.description: The first date to search, YYYY-MM-DD in Australia/Brisbane time. Defaults to today; a past date means today.

date_to.description: The last date to search, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 60 days after date_from and is capped at 365 days after it.

limit.description: How many sessions to return. Larger values are capped at 50; values below 1 use the default.

location.description: The venue's id or name from listLocations, or a suburb only one venue has.

tools.name: start_booking
tools.description: Get the link that books one place in a session found with search_sessions or search_nearby_sessions. Give the link to the person: they open it, confirm, and finish on the enrolment site, where they enter their own details and pay themselves. This tool books nothing, holds no seat and takes no personal or payment details, so don't tell the person they are booked. The link is for one person: for a group, book each person separately or use the corporate enquiry page (/corporate).

session_id.description: The session_id from a search_sessions or search_nearby_sessions result.
